summary: Fresenius Medical Care AG filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited interim financial statements and operating segment data for the quarter and six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing includes standard IFRS segment reporting (healthcare services and products, care delivery/enablement) and references ongoing share buyback program tranches, but no announcement of a special situation: no merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, or capital return event. The filing is a routine periodic report, which does not trigger a special-situations classification.
